about.label: About
about.title: Code that survives the <accent>next release</accent>
about.p1: I'm a Computer Science graduate focused on building web and mobile applications that are, above all, scalable and resilient. My technical foundation includes React, Next.js and Node.js, always with TypeScript.
about.p2: I don't just believe in 'writing code'; I believe in understanding the why behind architectural choices. From component design to database modeling, I seek the balance between fast delivery and code that won't cause headaches in the future.

borebi.title: Full Stack Development Intern
borebi.description:
- **Internal systems:** Built 4 internal web systems with Laravel and unified 3 into a single application — eliminating code duplication and reducing maintenance surface.
- **Modern frontend:** Developing the frontend with React and TypeScript via Inertia.js — SPAs with fluid navigation integrated into the Laravel backend without a separate API layer.
- **Database and routes:** Modeled and maintain a database with 13 domain entities and implement over 50 routes with authentication, role-based access control and input validation.
- **Requirements gathering:** Gathering requirements with non-technical public servants and digitalizing workflows replacing manual paper processes — covering registration, enrollment, analysis, appeal and reimbursement.
- **Evolutionary maintenance:** Refactoring critical sections of legacy systems and conducting deployment and evolutionary maintenance of production systems with Git and code review.

solidTech.title: Full Stack Developer
solidTech.description:
- **Full Stack & Mobile:** Built scalable ecosystems integrating high-performance interfaces (React/Next.js) with backend systems (Node.js/Prisma).
- **Smart TV:** Implemented digital signage and medical testing systems for Smart TVs using React Native TVOS with real-time WebSocket communication.
- **Gamification & Social:** Developed training engines with haptic feedback, social feeds, rankings, and achievement systems.
- **B2B & Financial:** Built admin dashboards with visual training builders and integrated financial modules for Pix checkout and subscription management.
- **Logistics:** Developed features for logistics systems covering customer, delivery personnel, and control panel apps.

funprev.title: IT Internship
funprev.description:
- **IT Infrastructure Troubleshooting:** Diagnosed and resolved issues in networks, devices, and IT infrastructure, ensuring system stability, security, and continuity.
- **Web Development:** Developed, maintained, and implemented features in internal web systems using PHP and JavaScript.
- **Data Management:** Managed data integrity and executed SQL queries, focusing on PostgreSQL and phpMyAdmin to support reporting and system updates.
- **Hardware & Software Setup:** Installed and configured software and hardware, ensuring proper operation of the technological environment.
- **Technical Support:** Provided user support with logical troubleshooting to minimize downtime and operational impact.
- **Network Administration:** Configured, monitored, and maintained network devices such as routers and switches.
